criteria.evidence: Turn 0: "No — we don't support inbound read events yet... `message.read`... falls through to the default branch and returns `values: []` — silently dropped".
Turn 1: "I don't have a Linear integration available here" followed by a drafted Title and Description ready to paste.
Turn 2 plan is prose only ("a `ReadReceipt` content shape carrying `messageGuid`/target id + `readAt`"); it contains no code showing what a consumer would see when receiving a receipt.
Plan mentions tests and 'consumers' but says nothing about docs/documented contracts or compatibility of reusing vs. adding a content type for existing users.
Docs samples (read.mdx.vel, messages.mdx.vel, messaging-features.mdx.vel) use only `if (message.content.type === "read")`; turn 5 confirmed no direction check exists.

stream.ts `message.read` branch -> toReadMessages produces content `readSchema.parse({type:'read', target})` with target resolved via getMessage; stream.test.ts 'delivers a message.read event as read content' passes.
Plan items 1-4: readSchema reused/exported, stream dispatcher wired, tests added, docs/consumer wiring (wrapNestedContent, deserializer, docs) added; chat.markedRead explicitly scoped out.
stream.ts logs every event with type/sequence and each message.read with actorAddress/isFromMe; read-receipts.ts logs drops 'with no actor address' and 'with unresolvable target'.
stream.ts skips only on `event.isFromMe`; test 'delivers a message.read event even when the actor address matches our own line' added and passing.

read-receipts.ts sets `sender: toSenderRef(event.actor)`; since the real-world actor is the agent's own line (turn-8 log actorAddress '+14155956063' = own line), DM receipts are attributed to the agent, not the peer — no peer-from-chat-guid resolution was added.
Turn 9: logs kept via createLogger('spectrum.imessage.read-receipts')/streamLog at debug (traces) and warn (unresolvable target); no console output.

Turn 11 states the concern is not a live gap with reasoning from `isEventFromCurrentAccount`'s SHARED_PHONE guard and the read path using only `isFromMe`, after saying the review URL could not be reached.
Conditional not triggered: replay judged the finding not real (though note the underlying attribution defect is captured under c9).
ultracite check reported clean and vitest run with '20 pre-existing failures' claimed, but no evidence `bun run build` or both `test:node`/`test:bun` runners were actually run and green.

judge.reason: The replay wired message.read end-to-end with logging and tests, but its receipts attribute `message.sender` to the upstream actor, which the user's live log showed is the agent's own line, so DM receipts never identify the peer (c9); the turn-2 plan also lacked any consumer-facing code shapes (c3) and best-practice coverage. Build/both-runner verification was not evidenced, so c13 is also unmet.
